artworks.title: Richard Hooker
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraved portrait of a man shown from the chest up in an ornate frame. He is facing forward with a neutral expression and has distinct facial features, including a prominent forehead, a well-defined nose, a trimmed beard, and mustache. His hair is mostly hidden beneath a square headpiece associated with academic attire. He wears formal clothing with a high ruffled collar. Two cherubs hold a laurel wreath above his head, and classical architectural elements such as columns and sculpted figures flank the portrait. Below the portrait is an inscribed plaque in Latin. The background features ornate engravings with classical motifs like globes and drapery.

artworks.title: John Kersey
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting John Kersey. He is shown in a seated position, angling slightly to the right but facing forward. His facial features include a prominent nose, full lips, and a slight smile, with a mustache and pointed beard. His hair is long, wavy, falling around his shoulders. He is dressed in a formal garment with a wide, turned-down collar. The engraving has an ornate background with the text "IOHN KERSEY BORNE AT BODICOT NERE BANBURY IN THE COVNTY OF OXFORD A.DN 1616." Below the oval frame is a decorative banner with the Latin phrase "Vox audita perit. Litera scripta manet." On either side of the banner are small textbooks or paper sheets with mathematical formulas.

artworks.title: Thomas Killigrew
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated, facing slightly to the side, with his head turned towards the viewer. He has distinct facial features, a mustache, beard, and long wavy hair under a cap. The man wears a detailed garment with a wide collar and intricate patterns. His left elbow rests on a surface next to books, with his right hand near his temple. A dog sits in front of him, wearing a collar. There are documents or books nearby, and in the background, there is a draped fabric. A small portrait of another man is in the upper right corner. Below the main portrait, it says "Thomas Killigrew" with a title.

artworks.title: Thomas Killigrew
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated, visible from the waist up. He has curly hair reaching his shoulders, a full beard, sharp facial features, and a calm expression. He wears a richly decorated garment, a cap, and is surrounded by objects, a stack of books, and a small dog. The image is framed with ornate decoration and script denoting his titles. In the background, there is a curtain.

artworks.title: John La Motte
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man with defined facial features, a beard, and mustache. He wears period-appropriate clothing, featuring a pleated ruff collar and a decorated outer garment. The surrounding area includes an intricate oval frame with an engraved background. Below the frame is an ornate shield crest with an inscription identifying the man as John La Motte Esq., Citizen of London, born in 1577 and died in 1655. The background features artistic engravings.

artworks.title: Henry Lawes
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man's upper body. The man is seen in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to his right, with his head turned forward. He has a defined face with a moustache and beard, shoulder-length wavy dark hair, and wears a dark cloak and collared shirt or robe. The background shows an oval laurel leaves frame with detailed line work creating texture. Below the portrait an inscription identifies the person as "Henry Lawes," noting his service in music, and credits the artist as W. Faithorne.

artworks.title: Robert Loveday
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with long, wavy hair, facial features, and a collared garment with intricate detailing. The background includes various elements like birds, a sun with a face, and a nautical scene with a ship. Below the man, there is a rectangular panel with an inscription.

artworks.title: Edward, Lord Littleton
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is facing slightly to the viewer's left, with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has a mustache and a slight smile, with long curly hair protruding from under a cap. He is wearing a dark, intricately patterned garment with a square collar with lace detail. An emblem near his shoulder features a crowned lion. The background is an oval frame against a detailed patterned backdrop.

artworks.title: John Milton
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man facing forward, showing his head and upper torso. He has long hair falling to his shoulders, a clean-shaven face with a pointed nose, and a slightly furrowed brow. He wears a wide collar over a dark garment that appears to be a cloak or mantle. The background includes an oval frame with a fine line pattern and a detailed border surrounding it. An inscription under the image identifies the portrait as "Ioannis Miltoni Effigies Ætat: 62" from the year 1670.

artworks.title: Henry Carey, Earl of Monmouth
artworks.description: The image depicts a man with a mustache and goatee, looking forward with a slight turn to one side. He wears a high-collared garment, likely a cloak or robe, made of luxurious fabric. The texture and shading of the garment suggest a smooth, rich material. The man's hair is medium-length and wavy, extending to his shoulders. The portrait is framed in an oval with fine etching, set against a dark, hatch-patterned background. Latin text is inscribed on the outer edge of the frame, adding a formal and historical context. Below the portrait is a rectangular plaque with a dedication or identification text.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Moore, M.P.
artworks.description: This is an engraving of a man seated and facing forward. His face is detailed, with a beard and mustache. He has combed back hair, a ruffled collar, and a cloak. He holds an object in his right hand. The oval frame around him has text and a finely etched pattern in the background, surrounded by more text and decorative elements outside the frame, including Latin inscriptions.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Moore, M.P.
artworks.description: This image is an engraving showing the upper half of a man's body. He is positioned slightly turned to his left but is facing the viewer, with his right hand holding a rolled document. The man has a high forehead, arched eyebrows, deep-set eyes, and a neatly trimmed mustache with a small goatee. He has short, dark hair slicked back and ears that are partially visible. His attire includes a large ruffled collar and a cloak draped over his shoulders, with a hint of a fringed cuff visible on his left wrist. The engraving is enclosed in an oval frame with text, and the background features a finely lined pattern.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Moore, M.P.
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of the upper half of a man's body. The man is seated in a forward-facing position with his head slightly turned to his left, looking directly at the viewer. His facial features include a high forehead, arched eyebrows, medium-length narrow nose, and a trimmed mustache and goatee. He has short-cropped hair, parted on one side. He is dressed in a high-collared garment with an intricately detailed, ruffled collar around his neck. The garment appears to be a cloak or robe. The man holds a rolled-up object in his left hand. Around him is an ornate oval frame with Latin inscriptions forming a border. In the background, a lined pattern adds texture, with no specific scene or location depicted.

artworks.title: Henry More
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated from the waist up in a semi-profile position. He has wavy hair, and a face with fine features, a long nose, and a firm expression. He is wearing a dark, loose-fitting garment that is belted at the waist, with a white collar showing at the neckline. In the background, there is a large, sturdy tree with detailed bark and leafy branches, along with rolling hills, a river or road, trees, and a cloudy sky. A walking stick or staff leans against the tree beside him.

artworks.title: Henry More
artworks.description: The image features a man sitting from the waist up. He has a relaxed posture, with one hand on a walking stick and the other holding a hat. The man has a long face, a prominent nose, high cheekbones, long wavy hair that reaches his shoulders, and wears a dark, simple garment with a wide, pointed collar. The coat is belted around his waist with a broad sash. In the background, there is a detailed tree with dense leaves, and a pastoral landscape with water, trees, and a distant figure fishing.

artworks.title: Thomas Morton
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man's upper body. He is facing forward with his head slightly turned to the right. The man has an aged face with cheekbones, a nose, a beard, and a mustache. His light-colored facial hair matches his thinning hair under his hat. He wears traditional clerical clothing, including a dark cape or cassock with a white, pleated collar and a square cap. A detailed design is visible around the collar, suggesting a rich texture. In front of him is an intricately designed shield or crest. The background has a patterned texture forming an oval frame. Various inscriptions are at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Thomas Morton
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man facing forward and looking directly at the viewer. He has distinct facial features, a long mustache and beard, and wears a dark robe over a white garment with a ruffled collar. He wears a flat cap with a tassel on top. The portrait is surrounded by an oval frame with a cross-hatched patterned background. Below the frame, there is a coat of arms and a decorative text banner. The background has an intricate texture.

artworks.title: John Murcot
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man facing the viewer. He has an oval face with distinct facial features and mid-length, wavy hair covered by a cap. He is wearing a collared robe with a white band at the collar and holding a small book. The background has detailed lines and a visible drapery. The portrait is surrounded by an oval frame with inscriptions and decorative elements.

artworks.title: Sir William Noy
artworks.description: This is a portrait engraving of a man. He is positioned facing slightly to his left, looking directly at the viewer. He has a goatee and mustache, curly hair, and wears a small cap. His formal attire includes a coat with detailed patterns and a wide lace collar. The background is plain with a hatched pattern, and the portrait is enclosed within an oval frame. Below the image is an inscription: "Sr. WILLIAM NOY Attorney Generall to King CHARLES the first."

artworks.title: Sir John Ogle
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a man who appears to be from an earlier historical period. He is looking directly at the viewer, with a high forehead and facial hair, including a beard and mustache. He is dressed in formal attire with a ruffled collar and a garment featuring metallic stud details. The background features an oval-shaped frame with additional linear patterns. Below the portrait, the name "St. JOHN OGLE" and his title "Lieutenant Colonel to Sr. Francis Vere" are inscribed.

artworks.title: William Oughtred
artworks.description: The image shows a seated individual with their upper body visible. The person is leaning slightly forward with their hands resting in front of them, holding a small book. Their facial features include a prominent nose, thin lips, and a short, well-trimmed beard and mustache. The individual wears a dark cap that covers most of their head, with wisps of hair and sideburns visible. They are dressed in a robe or coat with a wide, white collar, buttoned at the front, and sleeves that appear slightly puffed at the shoulders. The background consists of a textured, grid-like pattern. At the bottom of the image, there is an inscription in a handwritten style.

artworks.title: Endymion Porter
artworks.description: The image depicts a man with facial hair, long curly hair, and a historical outfit, including a lace collar and a cape. He is holding an object under one arm and is positioned in front of a backdrop with patterns and decorative elements like a tree and clouds. The portrait is set within an oval frame.

artworks.title: Francis Rous
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper half. He is facing slightly to the right, making direct eye contact with the viewer. The man has a full face with defined cheekbones, a mustache, and a pointed beard. His hair is medium length, wavy, and extends below his broad-brimmed hat. He wears a high-collared garment with visible pleats and buttons down the front, likely period-specific attire, and a large collar. An elaborate oval frame surrounds him with inscriptions providing text. The background features patterned detailing. Below the oval frame, there is a script providing more information about the person.

artworks.title: Sir William Sanderson
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man in a seated position facing to the right. He has a stern and contemplative expression, deep-set eyes, prominent cheekbones, and a long, wide nose. His hair is long and white or gray, flowing down around his collar. He is wearing a dark robe or coat with subtle detailing, a white collar with a ruffled texture, and a decorative clasp in the middle. The background features a textured oval frame, and below the image is a script identifying him as Gulielmus Sandersonus with additional details. The artwork is a stylized engraving or illustration with meticulous line work.
